statement: open KdVPlan in ∀ f g : Coeff, Smooth f → Smooth g → (fun k : ℤ=>(k:ℂ)*mul f g k)=mul (fun k : ℤ=>(k:ℂ)*f k) g+mul f (fun k : ℤ=>(k:ℂ)*g k)
proof:
exact (open KdVPlan in by
  intro f g hf hg
  have hs:=@yui_aux_0014 T gamma R h_E006 h_T005 h_T013
  have sh:=(@yui_aux_0039 T gamma R h_E006 h_T005 h_T013).1
  funext k
  change (k:ℂ)*(∑' j : ℤ,f j*g (k-j))=(∑' j : ℤ,((j:ℂ)*f j)*g (k-j))+(∑' j : ℤ,f j*((k-j:ℤ):ℂ)*g (k-j))
  rw [← tsum_mul_left,← (hs _ _ (sh f hf 0) (hg 0) k).tsum_add]
  · apply tsum_congr
    intro j
    push_cast
    ring
  · convert hs _ _ (hf 0) (sh g hg 0) k using 1
    funext j
    simp only
    ring)
